text: How does cosmopsychism attempt to sidestep the combination problem that troubles micropsychism?
choices: It denies that experience is a fundamental feature of reality
It restricts experience to systems with high integrated information (phi)
It claims the micro-experiences of particles simply sum arithmetically into macro-experience
It treats the universe's unified experience as primary, with individual experiences 'carved from' it rather than assembled from micro-parts
explanation: Cosmopsychism makes the cosmic experience fundamental and treats individual experiences as carved out of it, reversing the part-to-whole direction of constitution and so avoiding the need to combine micro-experiences. Denying that experience is fundamental abandons panpsychism; the phi restriction is IIT; and arithmetic summation is precisely what the combination problem shows to be inadequate.
